reading.title: The Coffee Shop 1: A short reading
reading.text: Maya meets Omar at the coffee shop. She orders a latte, and he asks for tea. The barista also offers espresso, cappuccino, and hot chocolate. Omar wants a warm drink today, so he keeps his tea order. Maya pays for both drinks, and they sit by the window to talk before work.
